title: Paloma and the Alibi
author: A. M. Reyes
blurb: Astrid Ishikawa, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
